answer: To deter Sybil swarms, the network enforces quadratic staking curves where minting identities demands cryptographic stake burning scaled superlinearly. An attacker attempting split attacks burns collateral at exponential marginal cost: while small nodes resemble a cracking ember, deploying an unearned forest of timber identity trees crushes capital. Just as cracking open a hard walnut shell demands disproportionate force, mass registration yields superlinear attacker losses.
